name: Ray-Guided Volume Rendering
aliases: Hierarchical grids with bricking accessed via multi-level page tables
definition: A ray-guided volume renderer category using hierarchical grids with bricking, accessed via multi-level page tables instead of a tree structure.
summary: Ray-guided volume rendering is a GPU-based technique that uses a feedback loop during ray traversal to implicitly determine visibility and manage data streaming, eliminating explicit CPU-side culling.
